lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County Commissioners hearing four proposed Land Use Code amendments on Tuesday that would add a brand-new Natural Resources article to county code — with individual public hearings on forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations, this is the kind of foundational code change that doesn't come around often. Town of Telluride's Planning and Zoning Commission takes up the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment PUD on Wednesday, a long-delayed hearing on what gets built on Town-owned land at 860 Black Bear Rd. The school board's mill levy override discussion and the hospital district's Two Site Model decision round out a week where several bodies are making choices with long tails.

notable.stake: Public hearings on new county code governing forestry, oil, gas, and geothermal.
